rows.quote: The research relies on data that is accessible to the public from a large-scale genome-wide association study on blood proteome (https://www.decode.com/summarydata/)12, plasma proteome analysis of European descent plasma(nilanjanchatterjeelab.org/pwas/)13 and GWAS Catalog (GWAS Catalog (ebi.ac.uk))14–16 (Supplementary Table 2).
rows.reference_quote: Zhang, J. et al. Plasma proteome analyses in individuals of European and African ancestry identify cis-pQTLs and models for proteome-wide association studies. Nat. Genet. 54 (5), 593–602 (2022).
rows.coder_note: Sentence attributes the plasma proteome data of European descent to citation 13, whose DOI is the dictionary source of the two ARIC rows; the stated European descent selects the European American row.
